title: Blue Prince
genre: First-person puzzle adventure / roguelite room-drafting mystery (draft a new floor plan of the manor each day to reach Room 46)
release_date: 2025-04-10 (PC/Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S; day one in Xbox Game Pass and PS Plus Extra/Premium) [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury press release via GamesPress; TheSixthAxis]; Mac (Steam + Mac App Store) later in 2025/26 [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury]; Nintendo Switch 2: 2026-03-03, shadow-dropped at Nintendo Indie World [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury, TechRadar]; physical Switch 2 edition by iam8bit (date TBA)
team_size: Small team; exact headcount: no data. Tonda Ros worked alone for years before the team grew; named credits: Tonda Ros (director/designer/writer), Davide Pellino (art director), Axel Haavikko (producer) [CONFIRMED – Ros in Unity blog interview; Wikipedia infobox]
country: USA (Hollywood, California) [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury project page]
developer_background: Dogubomb's debut game: nominated for The Game Awards 2025 Best Debut Indie Game and a GDC Awards 2026 Best Debut finalist [CONFIRMED – Game Informer; GDCA nominee list]. Ros started the project solo and found it hard to hand over control as the team grew; the team watched more than 2,000 hours of playtest footage [CONFIRMED – Unity blog interview].
publisher: Raw Fury (Sweden) [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury press release]
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569580/Blue_Prince/ ; PS5, Xbox Series X|S (+ Game Pass), Mac App Store, Switch 2 – https://rawfury.com/games/blue-prince ; https://rawfury.com/blue-prince-out-now-on-switch-2/
business_model: premium $29.99 / €29.99 / £24.99; day-one subscription deals with Xbox Game Pass and PS Plus Extra/Premium (terms not disclosed – no data); sales e.g. 20% off on PS Store, 34% off in the Raw Fury publisher sale (until 2026-04-27); Switch 2 launch discount
price_usd: $29.99 [CONFIRMED – Dogubomb community manager via Insider Gaming]
units_or_downloads: 2,000,000+ players worldwide across all platforms, including Game Pass/PS Plus players [CONFIRMED – Raw Fury/Dogubomb announcement via VGChartz; announcement date: no data]. Players ≠ copies sold. Steam copies: ~0.7M (range 0.6M–0.8M) [ESTIMATE – ~20,080 reviews × 30–40; low multiplier because it is a single-player puzzle game with an engaged community]. Trackers disagree widely: Raijin 334.6K (Sep 2026) vs an older Raijin page 884.5K; GameRevenueData 853K–962K. Console paid units: no data.
peak_concurrent_players: ~19,243 in April 2025 [CONFIRMED – Steam data via SteamCharts; Game*Spark citing SteamDB: ~19k]; tracker.gg 18,847; 7,180 on launch day (wnhub). Steam CCU understates reach because of the day-one Game Pass and PS Plus releases. Jan 2026 monthly peak: ~6,982 (SteamCharts).
steam_reviews: ~20,080 reviews, 86% positive ('Very Positive') (tracker snapshot, 2026); earlier 16,740 at 86.8%. Metacritic 92 (PC, 57 critics), cited as the highest-rated 2025 release (3DNews/IGM).
implied_review_multiplier: n/a (no official unit figure; the 2M figure is players across all platforms incl. subscriptions)
gross_revenue: Steam: ~$15.8M (range $13.5M–$18.1M) [ESTIMATE – 0.6–0.8M units × $22.49 ($29.99 × 0.75)]. Tracker estimates: Raijin $6.0M (Sep 2026) vs $21.6M (older Raijin page); GameRevenueData implies ~$18M gross (net $12.7M). Console sales and Game Pass/PS Plus licence fees: no data (undisclosed).
net_revenue: Steam: ~$10.6M (range $9.0M–$12.1M) [ESTIMATE – Steam 30% on first $10M, 25% above; × 0.93 refunds]. Split between Raw Fury and Dogubomb not disclosed. Game Pass / PS Plus day-one deal values not disclosed; they paid out on top of sales.
production_cost: ~$0.6M–$1.5M [ESTIMATE – years of solo work plus ~3–5 people in later years ≈ 100–250 person-months × $6k; Raw Fury porting and marketing spend not disclosed]. Early years were likely self-funded (opportunity cost).
development_time: ~8 years ('over eight years of development') [CONFIRMED – Unity blog interview with Tonda Ros]
why_popular: A fresh hybrid: a hand-crafted Myst-like puzzle mystery inside a roguelite room-drafting loop, so the house is reshaped every run. Layered secrets and meta-puzzles reward note-taking and community sleuthing. Universal critical acclaim (Metacritic 92), and day-one Game Pass/PS Plus let millions try it risk-free. Awards: BAFTA Games Awards 2026 Game Design winner; DICE 2026 Outstanding Achievement for an Independent Game and in Game Design (5 nominations); GDC Awards 2026 Best Design and Innovation Award (GOTY and Best Debut finalist); TGA 2025 Best Debut Indie nominee [CONFIRMED – BAFTA/Pocket Tactics, interactive.org, VideoGameCanon, Game Informer]. Balatro's creator LocalThunk publicly campaigned for it at TGA (Shacknews).
marketing_channels: Raw Fury PR and showcases (PS/Xbox/Game Pass announcement Feb 2025; Switch 2 shadow-drop at Nintendo Indie World); day-one Game Pass + PS Plus exposure; very strong critic reviews; awards-season press; puzzle streamers/YouTubers; Reddit/Discord communities solving secrets; dev endorsement from LocalThunk (Balatro); discount events; later ports (Mac, Switch 2, physical edition) extended the tail.
engine: Unity [CONFIRMED – Unity's official case study/blog; Wikipedia infobox]
art_style: Stylised first-person 3D with a hand-painted, illustrated look (art direction by Davide Pellino); blueprint/drafting motif.
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: code the room-drafting system, inventory/state tracking, first-person controller and save system; generate textures, props and stylised room assets; draft notes/letters/lore. AI cannot: design the interlocking, multi-layer puzzle web (the core value), keep hundreds of clues consistent and fair, replace years of iteration (the team watched 2,000+ hours of playtests), give it a cohesive art direction, or land a publisher/subscription deal. A smaller game in the same spirit is feasible solo; Blue Prince's depth is not. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity 6 or Godot 4, Meshy/Tripo + Blender for modular room kits, Scenario/Midjourney for painterly textures and in-world documents, ElevenLabs SFX/VO, Suno/Udio ambient music, a clue-dependency graph (spreadsheet/Yarn/Articy) to track puzzle logic.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 6–10 weeks, ~$300–$1,000 (Claude Max $100–$200/mo, 3D/image gen $30–$80/mo, audio ~$30/mo, Steam Direct $100) for ~20 rooms and one meta-puzzle. Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 12–18 months, ~$6,000–$25,000 (tools ~$300/mo, freelance art direction/3D polish $2k–$12k, music $1k–$5k, external puzzle playtesting + marketing $1k–$5k). Excludes developer living costs.

data_conflicts: Steam units: Raijin's current page 334.6K / $6.0M (Sep 2026) vs an older Raijin page 884.5K / $21.6M vs GameRevenueData 853K–962K; chose 0.6–0.8M from reviews × 30–40 as a middle ground. Peak CCU: 19,243 (SteamCharts) vs 18,847 (tracker.gg); Raijin's 6,972 is a monthly peak, not all-time. The 2M players figure mixes subscription and paid players and has no date. PS Plus tier: 'Extra' vs 'Extra and Premium' (Premium includes Extra, so both are right). TGA 2025: Best Debut Indie nominee (it lost); press calling it a 'snub' refers to GOTY. Switch 2 launch discount reported as $19.79 (34% off) by one source and 'launch-week discount' by another. Exact team headcount not found.
notes: Award-winning design benchmark rather than a pure sales outlier: ~19k Steam CCU peak because subscriptions absorbed much of its console and PC audience. For solo creators: a publisher plus day-one Game Pass/PS Plus de-risks a long solo project; 'roguelite structure around hand-made puzzles' is a fresh hook, but its value comes from design depth that AI cannot shortcut. Long tail via ports (Mac, Switch 2, physical).
